pr_body:
We are currently fetching fields added by the fields API by name which breaks support for wildcards. More over, in case wildcards are used and those wildcards matches the geo field, then a ClassCastException is thrown.

This commit changes the strategy on how those fields are fetched by just iterating over the returned map. In addition, the geo field is added the last one on the fields list so it does not get overridden.

fixes  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/85592
pr_title: Fix fields wildcard support to vector tile search API

review_comment: I presume this means that the last fetch field that matches dominates?
Yes, it populates a map so if it finds the same name it gets written over. If the behaviour changes, test should notice it.
